intro: Make a statement without saying a word. Emerald’s striking design & ergonomic support set the stage for leadership, allowing you to focus, lead, & perform in a space that feels as powerful as you do.

features.title: Premium design that makes you feel confident
features.text: Make a statement without saying a word. Emerald’s striking design & ergonomic support set the stage for leadership, allowing you to focus, lead, & perform in a space that feels as powerful as you do.

features.title: Built to last with robust design
features.text: Durability shouldn’t be a question. The sturdy outer profile of the back and armrests is crafted for longevity, living up to the Emerald name with strength that stands the test of time.

features.title: Plush comfort you can feel
features.text: No matter your height or posture, the wider seat and armrests provide ample room to move and relax. The generous seat makes sitting through long hours effortless, keeping you supported without feeling confined.

features.title: Easy adjustment for a personalised experience
features.text: Your chair should work for you. The CT mechanism lets you lock the recline in an upright position, while height adjustment ensures a perfect fit—no matter your stature.

features.title: Sleek aesthetics with a premium touch
features.text: Soft to the touch and designed with a chrome pedestal, the Emerald chair is available in both leather and leatherette to match your style and needs.

name: Emerald Full Back Leatherette Executive Chair
